[Introduction]
[ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
There's a sweet young Miss, I love to kiss,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                          [ch]G7[/ch]
but listen close and hear me[/tab]
[tab][ch]G7[/ch]
She's not my only love, I have another love,[/tab]
[tab][ch]G7[/ch]                       [ch]C[/ch]
and she'll just have to share me[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
But she's five foot tall, high heel and all,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]F[/ch]
she already knows[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                         [ch]C[/ch]
She had some competition, in a composition,[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]G7[/ch]                  [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]F[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]
known as polka on an old banjo[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                                          [ch]C[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, make that five string hot[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                       [ch]F[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, give it all you've got[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                                    [ch]Bb[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, watch them fingers go[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]                             [ch]F[/ch]
Of all the songs I guess, the one that I love best[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]C[/ch]                       [ch]F[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]
Is the polka on an old banjo[/tab]

[Banjo Solo]
[ch]C[/ch]   [ch]G7[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch] [ch]C7[/ch]  [ch]F[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]

[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
And when they start the band,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                                [ch]G[/ch]
she takes me by the hand, and I begin to swing her[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]
She knows I never miss, a chance to steal a kiss,[/tab]
[tab][ch]G[/ch]                       [ch]C[/ch]
or dance the polka with her[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]
I don't speak a word ,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                       [ch]F[/ch]
once I have heard, the one thing I love so[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]
She's caught in the middle,[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]
she played the second fiddle,[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]G[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]         [ch]F[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
to a polka on an old banjo[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                                          [ch]C[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, make that five string hot[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                                       [ch]F[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, give it all you've got[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                                     [ch]Bb[/ch]
Polka on a banjo, watch them fingers go[/tab]
[tab][ch]Bb[/ch]                              [ch]F[/ch]
Of all the songs I guess, the one that I love best[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]F[/ch]
is the polka on an old banjo[/tab]
